The drift is spec->code: the source module doc comment src/lib.rs:4-7 still claims the dylib and host 'dynamically link the same component-core and example-helloworld shared libraries', which contradicts the corrected spec. Correct spec + stale code doc => not spec-lag (not BACKFILL); a code-side defect against a correct spec => ALIGN. Per workflow constraints the .rs source is NOT edited; the fix stays queued.
